about: Forms real configurations use and no golden sends, with synthetic names: a placeholder in a condition, FILTERED 'OP' after a PIP on the right of IN, a double space after OR, a field key with a trailing space, and rules placed directly in a set rather than in a policy. Each probe is `<form> OR resource.a == 'y'` with a = n and a = y, unless its about says otherwise.

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
The condition holds ${x} where a list literal would stand: `subject.roles CONTAINS ANY ${x}`. Upload 400 if the condition language has no placeholder; if it is taken, the reads show what ${x} became.

The FILTERED PIP subject.parityR33Ids.filtered, declared with the case's resource type, stands on the right of IN with the suffix FILTERED 'READ': `resource.id IN subject.parityR33Ids FILTERED 'READ'`. Its route answers ["r33"], the resource's id. Upload 400 if the suffix may not follow a PIP on the right; if it is taken, a = n is true when the suffix reads the FILTERED PIP.
cases.condition: resource.id IN subject.parityR33Ids FILTERED 'READ' OR resource.a == 'y'

cases.about: Two spaces after OR: `resource.b == 'y' OR  resource.a == 'y'`. g6a-doubled-space refused two spaces before AND; upload 400 here too if a double space breaks the text wherever it stands.

The simplified policy has no condition key, and a key "condition " with a trailing space holding `resource.a == 'y'`. a = n true if the key is not the condition and the policy has none (an absent condition is true); false if the key is read as the condition; 400 if the upload refuses the key.
As r33gaps-key-with-a-trailing-space-simplified, in the ALLOW rule of a set: no condition key, and "condition " holding `resource.a == 'y'`.

The set holds no policy and a rules list with one unconditional ALLOW rule, as the older forms of configurations do. Both requests false if rules outside a policy take no part; true if they act as a policy of the set; 400 if the upload refuses them.
Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
